title: A8 Cascade Historian output
description: An Echo panel or null. Null is the ordinary answer: an echo asserts that a documented past episode shares this narrative's motif, and most narratives have no such case in the library. Echo text is retrospective and cited, never a forecast, which is what the future-tense-harm lint enforces on the way out.

why_null.description: Present when echo is null: which cases were considered and why none matched. Silence with a reason is an answer; silence alone is not.

model.description: The identity the agent reports from its own system context.
